whenToUse: Bringing people into a team or project.
Email invites sit alongside an invite link.
whenNotToUse: Handing out a link is enough (use copy link).
Importing a whole contact list to send in bulk.
Adding people directly without their consent.

alternatives.name: Tag Input
alternatives.reason: An input that collects several values as chips.

accessibility: The input connects to a label, and errors are tied with aria-describedby.
Each chip has a remove button that includes the email address.
When there's no one to send to, the button is disabled.
